title: Minimal SOP for the Rijndael S-box
summary: The reported Espresso optimization could not find a minimal SOP for the Rijndael S-box; determining one and its two-layer NAND implementation remains open.

formal_statement.body: Finding a minimal sum-of-products (SOP) form for the Rijndael S-box was infeasible using the reported Espresso-based two-level logic optimization. Determine such a minimal SOP form and, via De Morgan's laws, the corresponding implementation with two layers of NAND gates.

scope.domain: Two-level Boolean logic optimization for S-box implementations.
parameters: two NAND-gate layers — target implementation depth
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine a minimal SOP form for the Rijndael S-box and derive the corresponding two-layer NAND implementation via De Morgan's laws.

progress.summary: The source reports that finding the Rijndael S-box's minimal SOP with Espresso was infeasible. It also observes that De Morgan's laws convert an SOP form into a two-layer NAND implementation.
citation_labels: Nicolas Bordes et al., Thinking Outside the Superbox
